blurb: We are once again ready for the Winter Season here at IVGC. As one of the original indoor facilites in the area, we pride ourselves at being your one stop shop for indoor golf. With our state of the art machines (Tru Golf) we offer a way to keep your game fresh in the off season! We offer a wide variety of food and drink options, and also are available for other events, like birthday parties, corporate, etc.
